entries.title: Psalms 131:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents. Of David.>> LORD, my heart is not haughty, Nor my eyes lofty. Neither do I concern myself with great matters, Nor with things too profound for me.

entries.title: Psalms 131:2
segments: Surely I have calmed and quieted my soul, Like a weaned child with his mother; Like a weaned child [is] my soul within me.

entries.title: Psalms 131:3
segments: O Israel, hope in the LORD From this time forth and forever.
